curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can Duncan find his place during a summer vacation where he struggles to fit in?
curatedMovie.description: During an awkward summer trip with his mother and her overbearing partner, shy fourteen-year-old Duncan struggles to belong until he finds an unexpected refuge and an unlikely ally at the local Water Wizz water park.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A warm, easygoing comedy-drama that balances adolescent discomfort with breezy humor and light emotional stakes.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: The summer-vacation premise gives a shy teenager a difficult fit with his mother’s companions and an unexpected friend at Water Wizz.
